tagline: Margin protection and dead stock intelligence
problem: Sales teams confirm low-margin orders while dead stock locks working capital silently.
solution: Profit Guard blocks or warns on low-margin order lines and highlights slow and dead inventory with clearance suggestions.

features.title: Margin Guard
features.text: Warn or block lines below margin rules.

features.title: Dead Stock
features.text: Days without movement and capital locked.

seo_keywords: Odoo margin control, dead stock, inventory intelligence, profit protection
